exposure: 9 influential variables identified by machine learning techniques
outcome: Intraoperative hemorrhage during cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSEP) surgery
cohort: The study cohort comprised 1680 patients with cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSEP) diagnosed and treated at four tertiary medical institutions.
finding: An interpretable machine learning prediction model (Bayes) was developed and externally validated, showing good performance in forecasting the risk of intraoperative hemorrhage during CSEP.
